title: Nilpotent Jacobian maps in dimension three and stable tameness in block extensions
summary: We study polynomial maps in three variables with nilpotent Jacobian over a field of characteristic zero. The proposed classification reduces maps with linearly independent components to a family determined by a univariate polynomial evaluated at a quadratic coordinate. The geometric part of the argument produces two algebraically dependent constant linear combinations of the components. A derivation argument then yields the normal form over the original field.
